title: Standard Chair - incoming / periodic visual inspection
scope: Visual and manual inspection of an assembled chair. Does not cover load testing, torque verification or dimensional measurement.

requirements.title: Seat surface condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the top surface and visible edges of the seat panel for cracks, splits, delamination, deep scratches or surface damage.
acceptance_criteria: No damage that could injure a user
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the entire seat top from above, in good light, filling most of the frame.
visual_limitations: Internal ply defects are not visible in a photograph.

requirements.title: Backrest surface condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the front face and edges of the backrest panel for cracks, splits, delamination or damage.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the full front face of the backrest, straight on.
visual_limitations: Internal ply defects are not visible in a photograph.

requirements.title: Backrest attachment
requirements.instructions: Push firmly on the backrest and confirm it does not move relative to the uprights. Photograph one attachment point.
acceptance_criteria: Backrest does not rock or shift under hand pressure
requirements.photo_guidance: Close-up of the joint between the backrest and one rear upright, showing the fastener.
visual_limitations: Fastener torque and thread engagement cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Front left leg condition
requirements.instructions: Check the leg is straight, undamaged and its joints show no cracks or separation.

requirements.title: Front right leg condition
requirements.instructions: Check the leg is straight, undamaged and its joints show no cracks or separation.

requirements.title: Rear left upright condition
requirements.instructions: Check the rear leg / upright is straight and undamaged along its full length.

requirements.title: Rear right upright condition
requirements.instructions: Check the rear leg / upright is straight and undamaged along its full length.

requirements.title: Left side stretcher secure
requirements.instructions: Confirm the stretcher is present and both ends are attached.

requirements.title: Right side stretcher secure
requirements.instructions: Confirm the stretcher is present and both ends are attached.

requirements.title: Front seat rail condition
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, straight and attached at both legs.

requirements.title: Rear seat rail condition
requirements.instructions: Confirm the rail is present, straight and attached at both uprights.

requirements.title: Seat mounting brackets
requirements.instructions: Turn the chair over safely. Inspect all four seat mounting brackets for presence, deformation and cracks.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the underside of the seat showing the brackets and their fastening points.
visual_limitations: Fastener torque cannot be verified visually.

requirements.title: Seat screws present and tight
requirements.instructions: Confirm all four seat screws are present and none turns by hand.

requirements.title: Backrest bolts present
requirements.instructions: Confirm all four backrest bolts are present and seated.

requirements.title: Floor glides present
requirements.instructions: Confirm a floor glide is fitted to each leg and the chair does not rock on a flat floor.
